_about: SWINGFIX v103 (Scripts/SwingFix.cs). Every look switch is false = today's frames; flip one only after Dom's LOOK OK. swingSeparation.padM 0 = today's sim; any padM > 0 is a SIM CHANGE (re-run balance and simhash gates).

swingSeparation._about: Extra metres on dodge.json minSeparation/separationPad while either fighter is in `states`, and on the lunge stop distance (DuelFighter.StepStopDist). Cause: the clamp is root-to-root (capsule radius 0.4) but a swing leans the shoulder and blade 0.3-0.5 m ahead of the root, so the clamp-legal gap of 1.5 m still leaves arm and blade inside the other torso. _proposedPadM is a first guess, not applied: run apply_swingfix.py --apply --swing-pad 0.35, then camproof pairs, balance and simhash.

finisherPreStagger._about: Presentation only. Victim state `clip` (must exist in its controller) starts atS seconds into the scene, before the finisher victim clip, so a short killer's overhead chop lands on a hunched head, not a standing chest. An exact killer or victim id beats '*'.

gripCombatInLoco._about: While on, weapon_grip.json rows of these characters whose `states` list names any of these states are skipped, so locomotion uses the combat grip row (blade follows the forearm). The sword socket is parented to the hand bone: there is no IK.

faceCast._about: Lights that lose the character light-layer bit at runtime (bit read from hdrp_char_layer.json charBit). Furnace_LavaUp (hdrp_furnace.json: point, 6000 cd, colour 1.0/0.2/0.04, range 10) is in neither doorLightContains nor keepLights, so HdrpCharLayer gave it the character bit.
